scientific_integrity: The analytic proof, equality cases, and sharp spectral gap have been reviewed together with a separately constructed exact-arithmetic checker. Finite tests are corroborative, not a substitute for the analytic angle optimization. The novelty assessment is necessarily literature-limited.
scientific_limitations: Real homogeneous degree-two spherical harmonics on the unit two-sphere only.
Optimality only for equally weighted equilateral triples on each of two great circles; not all six-node designs.
Full independence from every unindexed historical frame-design formula is not established.
No independent mathematical audit or external validation performed.
title: Sharp six-sample reconstruction of real quadratic spherical harmonics from two great circles
